generation: fresh fork_turns=none agent for each condition-case, one answer per session
model: same inherited default model/reasoning; no override or fixed seed
tools: read allowed local guides/prompts, save own output; no network/install/render/subagents
available_mermaid_guide: inputs/mermaid-diagrams/SKILL.md and its references; advertised to all conditions with same wording; use according to assigned Skill
reading_scope: own assigned Skill plus advertised optional Mermaid guide, common prompts; instruction-limited shared filesystem
review: source-hidden independent review, root evidence checks
invocation_measurement: Read provenance for whether optional Mermaid Skill was loaded; not proof of real client automatic invocation
